review.why: Builds and maintains Cloudflare Sandbox apps on the stable package: a package gate, the exec and session contract and a map to the main docs.
review.summary: Checks the dependency and image are stable and redirects preview apps to the other skills. The contract: exec takes a command string and resolves when the command finishes with buffered output, long-running work uses the process and stream APIs, sessions can keep directory and environment, prefer RPC transport, keep live credentials in the Worker and do not apply preview calls.
strengths: Same gate pattern prevents mixing package lines
Clear difference between the stable and preview exec models
Says existing apps can stay on stable and no port is forced
cautions: Stable line may change when 1.0 lands
Depends on installed types and live docs
